```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(urbnthemes)
library(urbnmapr)
set_urbn_defaults(style = "map")
library(ggspatial)
library(ggstar)
```

```{r define colors}
rfk_west_color <- "#ec008b"
rfk_east_color <- "#55b748"
metro_sta_color <- "#000000"
rfk_stadium_star_color <- "#fdbf11"
rfk_stadium_star_color2 <- "#db2b27"
```

```{r load data}
rfk_tracts <- read.csv("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/rfk_tracts.csv")
  rfk_tracts$GEOID <- as.character(rfk_tracts$GEOID)

censustrend <- read.csv("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/census_trends_2000_2020.csv") 
  names(censustrend)[names(censustrend) == "Geo2020"] <- "GEOID"
  censustrend$GEOID <- as.character(censustrend$GEOID)
  
censustrend_rfk <- rfk_tracts %>%
  left_join( censustrend, by = "GEOID") 

squares <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Square_Boundaries/Square_Boundaries.shp")

tracts <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Census_Tracts_in_2020/Census_Tracts_in_2020.shp")

rfk_tracts_shape <- tracts %>%
  left_join(rfk_tracts, by = "GEOID")

censustrend_shape <- tracts %>%
  left_join(censustrend, by = "GEOID")

wards <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Ward_-_2022/Ward_-_2022.shp")

dc <- wards %>%
  st_combine()

anc <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/OCTO/Maps/Advisory_Neighborhood_Commissions_from_2023.shp")

roads <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Roads/Roads.shp")

water <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Waterbodies_2023/Waterbodies_2023.shp") %>%
  mutate(water = "Waterways")

metro <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Metro_Stations_Regional/Metro_Stations_Regional.shp") %>%
  mutate(line1 = case_when(LINE == "blue, yellow"~ "yellow",
                           LINE == "blue, orange, silver"~ "blue",
                           LINE == "blue, silver"~ "blue",
                           LINE == "green, yellow, orange, blue, silver"~ "green",
                           LINE == "green, yellow"~ "green",
                           LINE == "red, green, yellow" ~ "green",
                           LINE == "red, blue, orange, silver"~ "red", 
                           LINE == "red, green" ~ "green", 
                           LINE == "orange, silver" ~ "orange"
                           ),
         line_name = if_else(is.na(line1), LINE, line1), 
         line_color = if_else(line_name == "silver", "grey", line_name))
dc_metro <- metro %>%
  st_filter(., dc, .predicate = st_intersects)

bus <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Metro_Bus_Stops_2023_-_2025/Metro_Bus_Stops_2023_-_2025.shp")

national_parks <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/National_Parks/National_Parks.shp") %>%
  mutate(parks = "National Parks")

build_permits <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Building_Permits_in_2025/Building_Permits_in_2025.shp")
rfk_permit <- build_permits %>%
  filter(OBJECTID == 1097829048) %>%
  #filter(FULL_ADDRE == "2400 EAST CAPITOL ST SE, WASHINGTON, DC 20003") %>%
  mutate(label = "RFK Stadium")

#create dataframe with stadium coordinates
#stadium_coord <- data.frame(lon = -76.9718667, lat = 38.8898532)

#convert to sf object and set coordinate system reference
stadium_sf <- st_as_sf(data.frame(lon = -76.9718667, lat = 38.8898532), coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
```

```{r define zoom-in area}

# Filter to Ward 7
ward7 <- wards %>%
  filter(WARD_ID == "7")

ward6 <- wards %>%
  filter(WARD_ID == "6")

#Find ward 7 coordinates, for zooming in on area
ward7coords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(ward7)))

#find x where y is max in ward 6 for x minimum
ward6coords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(ward6))) %>%
  filter(Y == max(Y))


#minimmum of Y
ymin = min(ward7coords$Y)
ymax = max(ward7coords$Y)
xmin = ward6coords$X
xmax = max(ward7coords$X)

#DC Coordinates
dccoords = as.data.frame(unique(st_coordinates(wards)))

dcymin = min(dccoords$Y)
dcymax = max(dccoords$Y)
dcxmin = min(dccoords$X)
dcxmax = max(dccoords$X)


#new maps
full_map_new <- ggplot() + 
  #RFK focus areas
  geom_sf(data = rfk_tracts_shape, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = rfk_sub_group2), colour = NA) + 
  #National Parks
  geom_sf(data = national_parks, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = parks), colour = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  #Water
  geom_sf(data = water, aes(geometry = geometry, fill = water), colour = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  #RFK Stadium square
  #geom_sf(data = rfk_square, aes(geometry = geometry), colour = "white", fill = "white") +
  #display a star at stadium coordinates
  geom_sf(data = stadium_sf, aes( geometry = geometry, color = "RFK Stadium" ), shape = "\u2605", size = 5) +
  #Metro stations
  geom_sf(data = dc_metro, aes( geometry = geometry, color = "Metrorail Stations" ), shape = 15, size = 1.5) +
  #Wards
  geom_sf(data = wards, aes(geometry = geometry), colour = "#5c5859", fill = NA)  +
  #Ward names
  geom_sf_text(data = wards, aes(geometry = geometry, label = paste0("Ward ", WARD_ID)), colour = "#5c5859", size = 3) + 
  #assign colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "RFK West" = rfk_west_color,
    "RFK East" = rfk_east_color,
    "National Parks" = "#98cf90",
    "Waterways" = "#73Bfe2"
    ),
    breaks = c("RFK East", "RFK West"), #Control what appears in legend
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "RFK Stadium" = rfk_stadium_star_color,
    "Metrorail Stations" = metro_sta_color
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  #adjust legend appearance
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(direction = "vertical"),
    color = guide_legend(direction = "vertical")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical", # Ensures the color box sits below or above the fill box
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.position = c(1.10, 0.05), 
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
  ) +
  #Filter to DC
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(dcxmin, dcxmax), 
    ylim = c(dcymin, dcymax),
    expand = FALSE) + 
  #distance bar (in miles)
  annotation_scale(unit_category = "imperial")
full_map_new
```
```{r create breaks}
censustrend_shape2 <- censustrend_shape %>%
  mutate(chgpop_interval = cut(
    ChgTotPop_2000_2020, 
    breaks=c(-1800,-200, 200, 700, 1300, 3352), 
    labels = c(
        "-1,800 – -200",
        "-200 – 200",
        "200 – 700",
        "700 – 1,300",
        "1,300 – 3,351"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      ordered_result = TRUE
    )
    )%>%
  mutate(chgBLKpop_interval = cut(
    ChgBlackNHBridge_2000_2020,
    breaks=c(-1900,-500, 0, 500, 1000, 1652),
    labels = c(
        "-1,900 – -500",
        "-500 – 0",
        "0 – 500",
        "500 – 1,000",
        "1,000 – 1,651"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      ordered_result = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r create outlines}

# for outlines of RFK areas
west_outline <- rfk_tracts_shape %>%
  filter(west_of_anacostia == 1)

east_outline <- rfk_tracts_shape %>%
  filter(east_of_anacostia == 1)

outlines <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = west_outline,
    aes(color = rfk_sub_group),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = east_outline,
    aes(color = rfk_sub_group),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "RFK East" = rfk_east_color,
      "RFK West" = rfk_west_color
    ),
    name = NULL
  )

outlines

```

```{r change maps}
pop_change <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = censustrend_shape2,
    aes(fill = chgpop_interval)
  ) +
  # Default is to use main urban palette, which assumes unrelated groups.
  # We adjust colors manually to be on Urban diverging palette.
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = palette_urbn_diverging[c(2, 4, 5, 7, 8)],
    name = "Change in Population 2000-2020"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = west_outline,
    aes(color = rfk_sub_group),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = east_outline,
    aes(color = rfk_sub_group),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  # Display a star at stadium coordinates
  geom_sf(
    data = stadium_sf,
    aes(color = "RFK Stadium"),
    shape = "\u2605",
    size = 5
  ) +
  # Metro stations
  geom_sf(
    data = dc_metro,
    aes(color = "Metrorail Stations"),
    shape = 15,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "RFK East" = rfk_east_color,
      "RFK West" = rfk_west_color,
      "RFK Stadium" = rfk_stadium_star_color2,
      "Metrorail Stations" = metro_sta_color
    ),
    limits = c(
    "RFK East",
    "RFK West",
    "RFK Stadium",
    "Metrorail Stations"
  ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.position = c(1.3, 0.0),
    legend.justification = c("right", "bottom")
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(dcxmin, dcxmax),
    ylim = c(dcymin, dcymax),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  annotation_scale(unit_category = "imperial")

pop_change

ggsave(filename = "C:/Users/lhendey/Box/Greater DC/Projects/RFK Stadium Analysis/Results/CensusTrends/population change.png",
       plot = pop_change,
       device = "png",
       width = 6.5,
       dpi = 1000)
```
